q1_issues.issue: The per-member distribution rule reuses the single indefinite witness sk_notebook_1, so it asserts that every Keeper in the group keeps that same one notebook — the collective reading licenses no rule at all, and the distributive reading requires a per-binding Skolem object (sk_notebook $x) as in the doctrine's dependent-existential pattern.

q2_gaps: Contentful / 'about' of-phrase on a concrete, non-nominalization, non-relational noun ('a notebook OF moth-counts and weather notes'): the possessive-genitive section explicitly excludes an about-phrase ('a photo of Mary') from Possession but names no replacement encoding, and the nominalization Of-oblique is scoped to nouns with an underlying verb — so the whole of-phrase (and both coordinated compounds) is unrepresentable and is dropped here.

Capitalized plural kind-word label under a quantifier ('a few Keepers'): the capitalized-common-noun default is stated as 'singular-collective only', and the Name-only plural rule is stated only for a plural 'referring as a name' ('the Wrens'), leaving a quantified capitalized plural unrouted between kind-typing and Name-only individual.
notes: Group witness + CardinalityPhrase "a few", the group event alongside the per-member rule, the Theme role for keep, and the unmarked habitual tense are all correct; the sole encoding fault is the shared notebook symbol inside the rule.
